**Opereret = 1** is a critical administrative variable used within the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen|Akut Kirurgi Databasen]] (AKDB), Denmark's national quality database for acute high-risk abdominal surgery [^src1]. The variable specifically defines the subset of the patient population that possesses both an inclusion diagnosis and an inclusion operation [^src1]. 

This variable serves as a cornerstone for the local validation procedures conducted by hospitals and regions [^src1]. During these validation exercises, clinical staff compare their own registrations in the Electronic Patient Record (EPJ) against data reported to the National Patient Register (LPR) and subsequently transferred to the AKDB [^src1]. Relying on precise variable definitions like "Opereret = 1" ensures that the reported patient population accurately reflects clinical reality, enabling exact data extraction and supporting the broader quality improvement strategies driven by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Program (RKKP) [^src1].
